$comment: Measured tuning constants. Generated by scripts/calibration/analyse.py from scripts/calibration/data/measurements.ndjson — do not edit by hand. build.rs turns this into compile-time constants, so a value here is the value the estimator uses, and `evidence` is what it rests on.
hardware: 2x NVIDIA RTX 3090 (24 GiB), AMD Ryzen Threadripper 3960X (24 cores), 251 GiB RAM

DEEPSEEK4_CSA_KV_BYTES_PER_TOKEN_LAYER_F.doc: deepseek4 compressed-sparse-attention KV bytes per token per layer at f16.
DEEPSEEK4_CSA_KV_BYTES_PER_TOKEN_LAYER_F.evidence: measured on DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Not re-fitted in this campaign; the KV term was not separated from the total.

DEFAULT_CACHE_RAM_MB.doc: llama-server's own `-cram` default: the prompt cache's cap in MiB.
DEFAULT_CACHE_RAM_MB.evidence: policy — llama.cpp's documented default, not a measurement. The cache does fill with use: 1.96 GiB of growth over 40 agent turns with -cram 8192 against 47 MiB with -cram 0 and more tokens generated.

DRAFT_MODEL_COMPUTE_MIB.doc: GPU compute buffer for a separate draft model, in MiB.
DRAFT_MODEL_COMPUTE_MIB.evidence: UNDER REVIEW alongside MTP_COMPUTE_MIB; one model, two contexts.

GEMMA_E_VARIANT_BYTES_PER_LAYER_TOKEN.doc: The Gemma 4 E-variant's per-layer embedding input, charged per layer per batch token.
GEMMA_E_VARIANT_BYTES_PER_LAYER_TOKEN.evidence: 24 E-variant cells at 1028 B/layer/token, against 40 same-architecture control cells at 3. 1028 is 257 f32 elements.

IK_MOE_CPU_BYTES_PER_NEMBD.doc: ik_llama's CPU-resident MoE op buffers, per batch token per unit of hidden size. Multiply by n_embd for the per-token figure.
IK_MOE_CPU_BYTES_PER_NEMBD.evidence: 40 cells below the offload threshold: qwen35moe 82944 B/token at n_embd 2048 (40.5/unit), laguna 110592 B/token at n_embd 3072 (36.0/unit), laguna 164966 B/token at n_embd 3072 (53.7/unit), glm-dsa 172032 B/token at n_embd 6144 (28.0/unit), glm-dsa 262963 B/token at n_embd 6144 (42.8/unit). Replaces a flat 81 KiB, which was this term evaluated at qwen35moe's hidden size and frozen.

IK_OP_OFFLOAD_MIN_BATCH.doc: Batch threshold below which ik keeps the MoE ops on the CPU: the term applies while `n_tokens * n_used < this * n_expert`.
IK_OP_OFFLOAD_MIN_BATCH.evidence: bracketed to (20, 32] by 48 ik MoE cells across two models with different expert counts; the term collapses from tens of MiB to hundredths exactly at the predicted crossing.

KV_CACHE_PAD.doc: llama.cpp pads the KV cache length to a multiple of this.
KV_CACHE_PAD.evidence: structural — read from llama.cpp's cache sizing, confirmed by the arena reproducing measurement to 0.1 MiB across 8 architectures.

MAINLINE_LAYER_SPLIT_MASK_COPIES.doc: How many times mainline replicates the graph's attention masks when layers are split across more than one device.
MAINLINE_LAYER_SPLIT_MASK_COPIES.evidence: 88 mainline layer-split cells at 4.00, against 168 single-card and tensor-split cells at 1.00. Flat across context, batch, slot count and cache mode; ik is 1.00 at either card count.

MAINLINE_TENSOR_MOE_BYTES_PER_NEMBD.doc: mainline's host-resident MoE intermediates under tensor split, per batch token per unit of hidden size. Multiply by n_embd for the per-token figure.
MAINLINE_TENSOR_MOE_BYTES_PER_NEMBD.evidence: 24 mainline tensor-split hybrid cells: laguna 62.7/unit, laguna 62.8/unit, qwen35moe 0.0/unit, qwen35moe 56.5/unit, qwen35moe 56.8/unit. Linear in batch — qwen35moe measures 28.3, 56.5, 113.0 and 226.1 MiB at ub 256, 512, 1024 and 2048, a constant rate. The same models under layer split show 0.02 MiB, so this belongs to the split mode rather than to the hybrid placement alone.

MTP_COMPUTE_MIB.doc: GPU compute buffer for a multi-token-prediction context, in MiB.
MTP_COMPUTE_MIB.evidence: UNDER REVIEW — originally calibrated against llama.cpp's own '[spec] estimated memory usage of MTP context' log line, which reports 708 MiB where the paired with/without cells show the driver reporting 2892 MiB more. The log line is not the cost. Pending a second data run.

MTP_HOST_BYTES_EMBEDDED.doc: Host cost of an embedded multi-token-prediction head.
MTP_HOST_BYTES_EMBEDDED.evidence: two models, one at two contexts. Under review for the same reason as the separate-draft figure.

MTP_HOST_BYTES_SEPARATE_DRAFT.doc: Host cost of a separate draft GGUF for multi-token prediction.
MTP_HOST_BYTES_SEPARATE_DRAFT.evidence: one model (gemma-4-31B-QAT) at two contexts. Under review — the paired with/without cells show the driver reporting a far larger delta than llama.cpp's own [spec] line, which is what the constant was originally fitted against. See FINDINGS.md.

NO_FLASH_ATTN_BYTES_PER_TOKEN.doc: Extra host bytes per batch token when flash attention is off, beyond the mask widening from f16 to f32.
NO_FLASH_ATTN_BYTES_PER_TOKEN.evidence: 18 cells across 9 architectures at two batch sizes. The excess over the widened mask is not uniform across architectures (4.25x on non-SWA models, 4.8-4.9x on sliding-window ones), so this is a representative value rather than a law.

PINNED_EXTRA_BYTES.doc: Slack between the arena llama.cpp reports and the pinned memory actually resident.
PINNED_EXTRA_BYTES.evidence: n=435 cells; the modelled arena reproduces the logged figure to within 0.1 MiB on a single card for qwen3, qwen35, llama, gemma3, gemma4 (non-E), lfm2, talkie, and deepseek4, on both runtimes.

PROCESS_BASE_BYTES.doc: Fixed per-process host cost: CUDA runtime, tokenizer, sampler, graph metadata.
PROCESS_BASE_BYTES.evidence: chosen for reachability rather than fit — the measured spread across 13 models is wide enough that no single value is close to all of them, so the constant is set so every model lands inside the rolling correction's [0.8, 1.5] clamp.

PROCESS_BASE_BYTES_MOE.doc: Flat additional allowance for a mixture-of-experts model.
PROCESS_BASE_BYTES_MOE.evidence: 5 MoE models. Four of the five run as --n-cpu-moe hybrids, so MoE-ness is partly confounded with the expert-offload regime; gemma-4-26B-A4B is the only fully-offloaded control.

PROCESS_BASE_BYTES_PER_DEVICE.doc: Additional host memory per *extra* visible CUDA device, beyond the first.
PROCESS_BASE_BYTES_PER_DEVICE.evidence: measured with placement pinned to the CPU so only the CUDA context count varies: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-U 19 MiB; gemma-3-27b-it-abliterat 20 MiB; Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-Q5_K_ 20 MiB going from one card to two.

PROCESS_BASE_BYTES_PER_LAYER.doc: The part of the process baseline that scales with layer count.
PROCESS_BASE_BYTES_PER_LAYER.evidence: 13 models spanning 16-79 layers. n_layer and n_embd correlate at +0.74 across the set, so the split between this term and a hidden-size term is weakly determined even though their sum is not.

compute_buffer_curves.$comment: Ordered: the first entry whose arch list contains the model's architecture wins, so a variant-guarded entry must precede the general one for the same arch. `slope_scales_with_ubatch` makes the slope linear in ubatch off the 512-token calibration point.

default.evidence: the llama-family fallback, used by any architecture without its own entry. Magidonia-24B (llama arch) measured in this campaign.

entries.evidence: gemma-4-E4B measured in this campaign; the E-variant also carries a per-layer host term, see GEMMA_E_VARIANT_BYTES_PER_LAYER_TOKEN.
gemma3 and gemma4 (non-E) measured across ctx 8192-65536 and both card counts.

inherited — no model with this architecture exists in the dataset, so this curve cannot be re-derived here and carries whatever the original ad-hoc calibration produced. See scripts/calibration/README.md.

GLM-5.2 measured at ctx 8192-131072 and ub 256-2048. The host-side arena for this architecture is exact; this GPU curve is a separate quantity and was not re-fitted.

Qwen3.6-35B-A3B measured across ctx and both runtimes.
Qwen3.6-27B measured across ctx and both runtimes.

talkie-1930-13B measured; its native context is 2048, so the sweep runs 512/1024/2048 and the slope is fitted over a 1.5k span where the base dominates. The base is well determined; the slope is decoration.
